hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d10 (or 6) + your Constitution modifier per paladin level after 1st

options.description: A martial weapon and a shield
Chain mail and a holy symbol

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: As an action, you can sense the presence of celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet that are not behind total cover. You also sense the location of consecrated or desecrated ground. The number of uses is 1 + CHA mod per long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: You have a pool of healing equal to 5 × paladin level. As an action, you can touch a creature and restore a number of HP from your pool (no Hit Die restrictions). Alternatively, expend 5 HP from the pool to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a fighting style: Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, or Protection (reactionally impose disadvantage on an attack against an adjacent ally).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: By 2nd level, you can cast Paladin spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. You prepare the list of paladin spells available to cast each day.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend a spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. +1d8 per slot level; +1d8 vs undead and fiends; +2d8 if on a crit.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet (30 feet at 18th level) gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1), as long as you are conscious.

features.name: Sacred Oath Feature
features.description: You bind yourself to a Sacred Oath: Devotion or the Ancients.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Ancients
subclasses.description: The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the race of elves and the rites of druids. Many of these paladins were members of the Green Faith or served the Elders that dwell in sacred groves.
subclasses.tenet: Kindle the Light. Through acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair. (and others: Shelter, Preserve, Conserve, Protect the Weak)

features.name: Tenets of the Ancients
features.description: Kindle the Light; Shelter the Light; Preserve the Light; Conscience before Convenience; Protect the Light.

features.name: Nature's Wrath (Channel Divinity)
features.description: As a magic action, you conjure spectral vines; each creature of your choice in a 15-foot cube within 30 feet makes a STR save or takes 1d6 damage and is restrained until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Turn the Faithless (Channel Divinity)
features.description: As a magic action, present your holy symbol: each fey or fiend within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute. (Alternative: fey and undead, per 5.2.)

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th) have resistance to damage from spells.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: When you are reduced to 0 HP and not killed outright, you drop to 1 HP instead (once per long rest). Additionally, you age 4 years for every year that passes.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description: As a bonus action, you transform for 1 minute: gain 10 HP per paladin level, shed bright/dim light 30 ft, deal +2d8 radiant damage with weapon attacks, hostile creatures in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against your Channel Divinity and spell save DC.

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.description: The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order. Sometimes called cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins meet the ideal of the knight in shining armor.
subclasses.tenet: Honesty. Don't lie or cheat. Let your word be your promise. (and others: Courage, Compassion, Honor, Duty, Loyalty, etc.)

features.name: Tenets of Devotion
features.description: Honesty, Courage, Compassion, Honor, Duty, Loyalty. Adherence to these tenets is how a paladin of the Devotion Oath demonstrates their commitment.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: As an action, for 1 minute you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with one weapon. The weapon emits bright light in 30 ft and dim light 30 ft. Expires early if you are incapacitated. Recharges on a short rest.

features.name: Turn the Unholy (Channel Divinity)
features.description: As a magic action, present your holy symbol: each fiend or undead you can see within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is turned.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft (30 ft at 18th level) can't be charmed while you are conscious.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.description: You are always under the effects of Protection from Evil and Good.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: As a bonus action, you emanate an aura of sunlight for 1 minute. You shed bright light 30 ft, dim light 30 ft; any hostile creature that starts its turn in the bright light takes 10 radiant damage; you have resistance to radiant damage, and your weapon attacks deal an extra 2d8 radiant damage on hit.

subclasses.name: Oath of Conquest

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Cast Command, Hold Person, etc.

features.name: Conquering Presence
features.description: Channel Divinity: Wis save or frightened 1 min (10 ft radius).

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: Channel Divinity: +10 to attack roll (must hit).

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.description: Reaction to deal 2d8+CHA mod Psychic damage.

features.name: Eternal Warrior
features.description: Advantage on CON checks; temp HP at start of each turn.

features.name: Conquering Victory
features.description: When you reduce creature to 0 HP, target another creature within 30 ft — Wis save or frightened.

subclasses.description: You seek to rule through martial dominance and strength over the weak.

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Cast Guiding Bolt, Enhance Ability, etc. (5e official list).

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.description: Channel Divinity: advantage on STR/DEX/CON checks, +10 walking speed for 1 min.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.description: Expend spell slot on Divine Smite: 1d8+slvl temp HP and inspire 3 allies.

features.name: Living Legend
features.description: Advantage on Charisma checks; Charisma max becomes 22.

features.name: Famous Champion
features.description: When a creature misses you, use reaction for an attack against it.

subclasses.description: You seek to spread glory across the land and prove yourself as a paragon of honor and excellence.

subclasses.name: Oath of Redemption

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Cast Sleep, Calm Emotions, Hold Person.

features.name: Rebuke the Violent
features.description: Channel Divinity: Reaction 2d8+CHA mod force damage to attacker.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.description: Channel Divinity (1 min): 10-ft radius. Damage taken halved; transfer to you.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: Reaction: take damage instead of a creature within 30 ft.

features.name: Protective Spirit Improved
features.description: You don't take the transferred damage; ally takes 50%, you take 50%.

features.name: Champion of Redemption
features.description: Aura to absorb damage; allies take 0 damage from your redirected hit.

subclasses.description: A knight who has seen too much violence, sworn to peace and atonement.

subclasses.name: Juramento de los Antiguos
subclasses.description: El Juramento de los Antiguos es tan antiguo como los elfos y los ritos druídicos.
subclasses.tenet: Encender la Luz, Refugio de Luz, Preservar la Luz, Conciencia antes que Conveniencia, Proteger la Luz.

features.name: Principios de los Antiguos
features.description: Encender la Luz, Refugio, Preservar, Conciencia sobre conveniencia, Proteger.

features.name: Ira de la naturaleza (Canalizar Divinidad)
features.description: Acción mágica: plantas espectrales en cubo de 4,5 m a 9 m; FUE o 1d6 y agarrado hasta fin de tu próximo turno.

features.name: Aura de guarda
features.description: Tú y aliados a 3 m (9 m nivel 18) tienen resistencia al daño de conjuros.

subclasses.name: Juramento de Devoción
subclasses.description: El Juramento de Devoción vincula al paladín con los más altos ideales de justicia, virtud y orden.
subclasses.tenet: Honestidad, Coraje, Compasión, Honor, Deber, Lealtad.

features.name: Principios de Devoción
features.description: Honestidad, Coraje, Compasión, Honor, Deber, Lealtad. Adherirse a ellos define al paladín.

features.name: Arma sagrada
features.description: Acción, 1 min: añade mod CAR a ataques con un arma; emana luz 9 m brillante + 9 m tenue. Recarga con descanso corto.

features.name: Rechazar a los impíos (Canalizar Divinidad)
features.description: Acción mágica; celestial/infernal/no muerto a 9 m salvación SAB o son rechazados.

features.name: Aura de Devoción
features.description: Tú y aliados a 3 m (9 m nivel 18) no podéis ser hechizados mientras estés consciente.
